title: Claude Context Window and Context Rot
content: Each session with Claude has a limit called the context window, which Claude can remember. The context window is not infinite. The context window is shown by the context, which indicates how much of the context window has been used in the current session. It is important not to fill up the context bar, as doing so can lead to context rot. Context rot occurs when Claude starts forgetting things that happened at the beginning of the conversation. For example, it might forget a decision you made or write code that breaks something it already fixed. To mitigate context rot, the compact feature summarizes the entire session into something smaller, keeping only the important information.
